constraints: Event archetypes are cold possibilities, not pre-existing events.
A trigger requires an actual relevant state change, scheduled dependency or causal threshold.
Material events are instantiated in authoritative event/domain state before consequences resolve.
goals: evaluate only event archetypes causally implicated by current state changes
wake affected owners and instantiate supported events without forcing drama
reconstruction_policy: Use saved state changes, scheduled dependencies, event archetypes, owner knowledge and stable deterministic inputs. Never create an event merely because it would be interesting.
replanning_policy: After every trigger evaluation, remain active for future causal triggers; instantiate only supported material events and wake all affected owners.
safe_compaction_policy: Triggered evaluations may be omitted only when no relevant trigger occurred; multiple triggers remain ordered by exact causal time.
standing_orders: propagate event knowledge only through valid information paths
